tool_calls.name:
/bin/zsh -lc "cat > main.go.tmp <<'EOF'
package main

import (
	\"math/rand\"
	\"os\"
	\"text/template\"
)

func main() {
	tmpl := template.Must(template.New(\"greeting\").Parse(\"Hello World {{.}}\\n\"))
	_ = tmpl.Execute(os.Stdout, rand.Int())
}
EOF
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os
p = Path('main.go.tmp')
data = p.read_bytes()
with open('main.go', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(data)
    f.flush()
    os.fsync(f.fileno())
p.unlink()
PY
gofmt -w main.go"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os
p = Path('main.go')
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace('\\t_ = tmpl.Execute(os.Stdout, rand.Int())', '\\tif err := tmpl.Execute(os.Stdout, rand.Int()); err "'!= nil {'"\\n\\t\\tpanic(err)\\n\\t}')
tmp = Path('main.go.tmp')
tmp.write_text(s)
with tmp.open('rb') as f:
    os.fsync(f.fileno())
os.replace(tmp, p)
PY
gofmt -w main.go
cat main.go"

/bin/zsh -lc "cat > main.go.tmp <<'EOF'
package main

import (
	\"math/rand\"
	\"os\"
	\"text/template\"
)

func main() {
	tmpl := template.Must(template.New(\"greeting\").Parse(\"Hello World {{.}}\\n\"))
	_ = tmpl.Execute(os.Stdout, rand.Int())
}
EOF
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os
p = Path('main.go.tmp')
data = p.read_bytes()
with open('main.go', 'wb') as f:
    f.write(data)
    f.flush()
    os.fsync(f.fileno())
p.unlink()
PY
gofmt -w main.go"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os
p = Path('main.go')
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace('\\t_ = tmpl.Execute(os.Stdout, rand.Int())', '\\tif err := tmpl.Execute(os.Stdout, rand.Int()); err "'!= nil {'"\\n\\t\\tpanic(err)\\n\\t}')
tmp = Path('main.go.tmp')
tmp.write_text(s)
with tmp.open('rb') as f:
    os.fsync(f.fileno())
os.replace(tmp, p)
PY
gofmt -w main.go
cat main.go"
